row.scim_price_text: Starting at $0.10 per month per resource
row.evidence: HCP Terraform's SCIM setup guide says "Your HCP Terraform organization must be on an Essentials, Standard, or Premium plan", and Essentials is the entry paid plan (starting at $0.10 per month per resource).
row.notes: Usage-priced per managed resource, not per user: Essentials $0.10, Standard $0.47, Premium $0.99 per resource/month on the pricing page; Enterprise (self-managed IBM Terraform Enterprise) is custom. The docs list a Free plan (500 managed resources) that the pricing page no longer shows. SCIM 2.0 is on every paid HCP Terraform plan (not Free) with no upcharge, so status is free; SAML SSO is on all plans including Free and must be configured first. SCIM is documented for Okta and Microsoft Entra ID only, through custom/non-gallery SAML apps (the Terraform Cloud gallery apps in OIN and Entra do not support it), and only for standalone HCP Terraform accounts (not HCP-integrated or HCP Europe). Tokens expire after 30 days to one year with no alert. Deactivation marks the member inactive (still an org member); delete removes the user and deletes SCIM-managed accounts. Name fields are accepted but not stored. The self-managed Terraform Enterprise product has its own SCIM docs. Audit trails API: Standard and Premium per the API page, Premium only per the plan table (see conflicts).

auth.token_source: Organization settings > SCIM provisioning > Generate SCIM token (owners team only)
auth.token_expiry: 30 days to one year (mandatory, set at creation)

deprovision.data_retained: active=false sets the user's team membership status to inactive (still an org member); DELETE removes the user from the org and deletes SCIM-managed accounts, while manually-managed accounts are kept for other orgs.

roles.how: SCIM groups create teams of the same name and sync team membership; team permissions are set in HCP Terraform. The owners team cannot be SCIM-managed.

rate_limits.text: 30 requests per second shared across SCIM endpoints; 1 MB max request body

limitations.text: Only Okta and Microsoft Entra ID are supported, and both need a custom/non-gallery app; the Terraform Cloud gallery apps do not support SCIM.
Only standalone HCP Terraform accounts; organizations integrated with HCP are not supported.
Updates to the primary email of a linked existing user are ignored; change email in the HCP Terraform UI.
With SCIM on, users are not created at SAML login; they must be provisioned first.
Tokens expire (30 days to 1 year) and no alert is sent before expiry.

methods: bearer_token (user, team or organization API token)

capabilities.notes: delete_user = remove an organization membership; roles are team permissions.

endpoints.purpose: Invite a user to an organization
Remove a user from an organization
Add org memberships to a team
Remove org memberships from a team

rate_limits.text: Up to 30 requests per second to most endpoints, per user

limitations.text: Free organizations can only manage membership of the owners team.

okta.notes: OIN has a Terraform Cloud app (per HashiCorp's docs) that does not support SCIM; SCIM uses a custom SAML app with Push New Users, Push Profile Updates and Push Groups. OIN page not loaded.

entra.notes: Entra gallery has a Terraform Cloud app (per HashiCorp's docs) that does not support SCIM; SCIM uses a custom non-gallery enterprise app. Gallery page not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: SAML team membership via MemberOf attribute (ignored when SCIM is on)
